text:
lina: Quick sync — product is targeting tenant-isolation v2 for Apr 12 (≈3w). Need alignment across runtime / infra / security on sequencing and fallback. TL;DR: runtime = quantized KV cache + model-variant; infra = VPC + prewarm slots; security = key rotation / HSM gating. Who owns what?

mike: I can own runtime work. Need perf baseline though. What are expected p50/p95 token counts? If we enable continuous batching + 8k KV, we might see ~15% CPU uplift.

jess: Infra can provision VPCs and reserved nodes but need ~10 business days for prod-like testing. Also need the exact prewarm probe (endpoint + load profile) to validate.

owen: Security: we require a threat-model signoff and HSM/KMS plan for key material. Also need an ingress ACL design — will block without it.

sara: SRE note — canary window should be ~6h with slow-start ramp. We need a fallback route that flips to model-variant B automatically if latency > 1200ms for 5m. Also prefer circuit-breaker on error spike.

lina: OK noted. Provisional gating criteria: 1) perf within 10% of baseline p95; 2) deploys pass canary; 3) security signoff. Any objections?

mike: Can we add 'no >5% accuracy regression on eval set'? Runtime can run the eval harness in CI and publish delta. I'll wire it into the rollout dashboard.

jess: Infra needs the rollout policy (canary percent ramp), the exact CIDR ranges for the VPC, and whether this uses dedicated capacity or shared nodes. That affects lead time.

owen: Add for security: key rotation docs + automated acceptance tests (attempted cross-tenant access). Without that we can't approve.

lina: Let's meet Tue 10am PT. Agenda: gating criteria, canary policy, infra lead time, security signoff steps. Prep: @mike paste perf baseline + eval link; @jess paste provisioning ETA & CIDR; @owen paste review checklist. I'll send calendar.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy queued: tenant-isolation-v2/stage -> staging at 1765440200 by mike.

mike: Perf baselines: p50=85ms p95=320ms for current prod model @8k seq. Eval harness results: https://redwood.internal/evals/ti-v2 (CI run ongoing). Starting quantized run now.

jess: VPC CIDR: 10.240.0.0/18. Provision ETA: 7 working days once we receive the runbook + run credentials. Recommend dedicated capacity for consistent latency.

owen: Security checklist gist: threat-model doc, HSM integration steps, KMS policy changes, access audit, pentest signoff. I'll DM the template and required acceptance tests.

lina: Awesome — thanks all. If no blockers by EOD Mon we'll lock the canary policy and schedule the window. :thumbsup:
